job_description:
Lone Star College-University Park seeks Adjunct (part-time) Faculty to teach Artificial Intelligence courses. Teaching faculty provide the learning activities and support that lead to achievement of course objectives and contribute to the educational environment of the college and community. Adjunct faculty are hired part-time on a semester-by-semester basis contingent on student demand, and may teach a maximum of five classes per academic year across day, evening, and weekend schedules at various times and locations.

Essential job functions:
- Teach Artificial Intelligence courses at a variety of times and locations.
- Create engaging lessons that promote student involvement and application of the material.
- Submit required college reports and forms in a timely manner and utilize a course syllabus for each course following institutional guidelines.
- Meet with and advise students before/after class or by appointment, electronic communication, or other methods.
- Evaluate students to measure progress toward course objectives and inform them of their progress in a timely manner.
- Maintain professional relationships with students, colleagues, and the community; attend meetings, trainings, and orientations as required.

Knowledge, skills, and abilities: mastery of course content; demonstrated leadership with a collaborative style; excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to appreciate alternative viewpoints and work with a wide variety of people; interest in interdisciplinary teaching, service learning, and learning technologies; commitment to academic excellence and lifelong learning; ability to use effective strategies to engage students.

Required qualifications: Associate degree in artificial intelligence, data analytics, computer science, computer information systems/technology, computer engineering, or a related business/computer field, with either 3 years of nonteaching work experience in the field or industry certification(s); OR a Master's degree with 18 graduate hours in a specific area of technology.

Pay: \$55.44 per contact hour. Benefits include a supportive collegial environment, work/life balance, tuition waiver, a tax-deferred retirement plan, and professional development opportunities.
company_details: Lone Star College (LSC) offers high-quality, low-cost academic transfer and career training education to 80,000+ students each semester and has been named a Great Colleges to Work For institution by the Chronicle of Higher Education. LSC-University Park, in northwest Houston, is recognized for innovation and a focus on student access and success, with facilities including the Center for Science & Innovation and the Energy & Manufacturing Institute.

csv_row.Location: Houston, TX 77070 (20515 SH 249, TX 249 and Louetta Road) - part-time adjunct; day, evening, and weekend classes at various locations. E-Verify employer
csv_row.Required Skills: Mastery of AI course content; teaching and lesson design that promotes student involvement and application; syllabus development following institutional guidelines; student evaluation and advising; excellent oral, written, and interpersonal communication; demonstrated leadership emphasizing collaboration, teamwork, and facilitation; interest in interdisciplinary teaching, service learning, learning technologies, course development, and adult learning methodologies (collaborative learning, learning communities, distance learning); effective use of instructional technology and student-engagement strategies.
csv_row.Years of Experience Required: Associate degree in AI/data analytics/computer science or related field plus 3 years nonteaching field experience or industry certification(s); OR a Master's degree with 18 graduate hours in a specific area of technology
